capabilities._note: Text to image only; flux2_klein_edit is the same model reading reference images.

template._note: Sizes a series ref is generated at (as krea2's). A keyframe is generated at its shot's render size, scaled up (same aspect, multiples of size_multiple) to at least min_pixels: the video targets scale a keyframe to the frame anyway, and FLUX.2 draws poorly far below its 1 MP training size.

recipe._note: Series refs are worded as krea2 words them (targets/image/common.py). Keyframes: targets/image/common.py keyframe_prompt.

binding._note: An API graph built from the user's saved image_flux2_text_to_image_9b.json (ComfyUI's FLUX.2 Klein 9B text-to-image template, its subgraph flattened and its Width / Height primitives inlined): UNETLoader + CLIPLoader flux2 + the small-decoder VAE, CFGGuider, KSamplerSelect euler, Flux2Scheduler, RandomNoise, EmptyFlux2LatentImage, SamplerCustomAdvanced. The saved copy loads the base model (flux-2-klein-base-9b-fp8, not installed here) at 20 steps, cfg 5; the preset renders the installed distilled Klein 9B KV model at the distilled settings (4 steps, cfg 1, as ComfyUI's Klein 9B distilled and KV templates run it), and `base` is the saved workflow's own. Width and height go to both the latent and the scheduler. H3SaveRefTake takes the place of SaveImage.

models._note: Families from the installed files' headers (targets/modelid.py). Klein 9B base, distilled and KV share their tensors: `exclude` keeps a substitute for the distilled model from being the base (which needs 20 steps and cfg 5: that is the `base` preset). The model is an accelerator: without a distilled Klein 9B the pass renders `base` (the base model, 20 steps, cfg 5), as the saved workflow does. The text encoder and VAE are required.

presets._note: The distilled Klein 9B KV at ComfyUI's distilled settings: 4 steps, cfg 1, euler. At cfg 1 the negative prompt has no effect (a take says so when one is set). `base` is the saved workflow's: the base 9B at 20 steps, cfg 5.

downloads._note: The installed flux-2-klein-9b-kv.safetensors has no record under that name (the templates name BFL's fp8 file, listed here too: it is the same model, and resolves by family).
